summary: Gùgōng is a mid-weight worker-placement game where the central twist is exchanging your currency tokens back into the general supply and back each round, forcing careful economic timing alongside area majority in the Forbidden City. It plays lean and fast for the genre.
praised: quick turns and playtime for a worker-placement game
criticised: area-majority scoring sometimes feels like an afterthought next to the token economy
card draw luck limits pure strategy for some

interaction.detail: Players compete for limited action spaces and for majority control on the palace track, but each otherwise builds a private tableau of goods and cards mostly independent of rivals.

subsystems: resource collection via the rotating wheel
banquet card set collection on personal grid
scoring.how_you_win: Place workers each round to gather resources, spend them on banquet cards that fill your personal grid for pattern bonuses, and add majority bonuses on the resource tracks at the end of a fixed number of rounds.
